response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack development experience with a strong foundation in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, as well as relational database systems. His background in energy-related projects (GISCollective) and AI-agent infrastructure aligns well with the role's focus on renewable energy and digital platforms. While he has more senior-level experience than the entry-level requirement, his pragmatic, scalable approach and collaborative mindset make him a strong candidate.
strengths: Profound fullstack expertise with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL/SQL
Experience with energy/geospatial platforms (GISCollective) and AI/ML integration
Strong DevOps and cloud knowledge (Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD) with a clean architecture focus
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role due to 11+ years of senior-level experience
Limited direct experience with NestJS (uses Node.js/Express primarily)
German language skills are basic, which may impact on-site collaboration
